content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary of the review (ASSIGN — deviation, preferred target):**

- **15.6 (p0814):** PB already has the preferred affiliate and successor/M&A carve-outs — those two elements are already met. But the carve-out runs to "either Party," so SFJ can also assign without our consent, and no reasonableness standard applies to consent. Cured by two surgical edits (carve-out limited to PB; consent "not to be unreasonably withheld").
- **15.6, competitor bar (p0817):** the prohibition on SFJ transferring to a pharma/biotech competitor expired at Program Transfer; now applies at all times, waivable only in PB's sole discretion.
- **14.2.6 (p0765–p0766):** walk-away term — SFJ could terminate in its sole discretion on a PB Change of Control, with a 150% Development Costs payment. Removed the termination right and conformed the stranded consequence paragraph so no dangling mechanic remains; the PB notice sentence is preserved verbatim.
- Left untouched as favourable/neutral to us: PB's Change of Control Buy-Out Option (6.7.2) and SFJ's limited-partner/liquidating-trust right to assign receipt of Approval Payments.
